data.description:
## Description

**What**: Wire the `code-reviewer-verifier` into the local `/dso:review` REVIEW-WORKFLOW dispatcher as a Claude Code sub-agent with `Read`, `Glob`, and bounded Bash allowlist (`grep`, `stat`, `ls`, `file`).

**Why**: The local path must enforce the same verification semantics as CI so that local runs catch invalid findings before they are committed or escalated.

**Scope**:
- IN: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md dispatch updates; sub-agent dispatch configuration with bounded Bash allowlist; `git show <reviewed_sha>:<path>` file reads (not live working tree); snapshot SHA propagation in local path; minor findings bypass verifier; ruling routing in local path
- OUT: CI runner.py changes (S4), feature flag (S6), telemetry emission (S6)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, local `/dso:review` dispatcher dispatches `code-reviewer-verifier` as a Claude Code sub-agent with `Read`, `Glob`, and bounded Bash allowlist (`grep`, `stat`, `ls`, `file`) between reviewer dispatch and `record-review.sh`; minor findings bypass the verifier
  ← Satisfies: "Local /dso:review reviewer pipeline dispatches the verifier as a Claude Code sub-agent with Read, Glob, and bounded Bash allowlist"
- When this story is complete, local verifier reads files via `git show <reviewed_sha>:<path>` (not live working tree); `<reviewed_sha>` captured at reviewer-dispatch time propagates through reviewer → verifier → `record-review.sh`
  ← Satisfies: "The verifier reads files via git show reviewed_sha:path (not the live working tree)"
- When this story is complete, verifier rulings applied in local path: same semantics as CI path (confirm/downgrade-to-minor/drop)
  ← Satisfies: "Verifier rulings have explicit semantics in the autonomous-resolution loop"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Security] Local Bash allowlist must be enforced — verifier must not run arbitrary commands; implementation must prevent the allowlist from being bypassed
- [Maintainability] Local path (live `git show`) and CI path (pre-packaged) are structurally different. Document the shared assumption that all reviewed paths must exist at `<reviewed_sha>`, and specify behavior when they do not (verifier emits `verifier_status: failed`, fail-open per S3). This shared contract is required for S7's ≥95% cross-path equivalence.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO local reviewer, the verifier runs as a Claude Code sub-agent with bounded Bash allowlist in the /dso:review REVIEW-WORKFLOW path
